question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

They must have been more than just __suspicious__ of you.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word **"suspicious"** means having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something (संदेहजनक). 
 
• The correct antonym for this word is** "Definitive**," meaning (of a conclusion or agreement) done or reached decisively and with authority (निर्णायक). 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is-** 'Definitive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ambiguous:** Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning (अस्पष्ट)
 
• **Doubtful:** Feeling uncertain about something (संदिग्ध)
 
• **Queer:** Strange or odd (विचित्र).
